requirements.case: Chinese varieties request, agreement, and extracts receipt
requirements.requirement: The January14 cover asks Gray to enlist Birch; its separate complete enclosure contains two substantive enquiry paragraphs and a signature. Both are Darwin prose with distinct source scopes. January19 records agreement, February6 willingness and a proposed visit, March12 a conditional Friday appointment, and April8 receipt of extracts. Keep those stages separate; no exact incoming Gray/Birch wording or physical delivery day is supplied. Later publication citations cannot substitute for the missing extracts.

exact_source_evidence.quote: will you be so kind as to help me this time in regard to the enclosed memorandum, with Mr. Birch.
I write one line to say how very sincerely obliged I feel to you, for so very kindly acceding to my troublesome request.—
I write merely to say that I have received the extracts, which you have so kindly made for me, & which I am extremely glad to see
I shall be in London in a fortnight’s time
call on you on Friday about 11 oclock

enclosure_proof.text: Is there any translation of any Chinese work, ancient or modern, descriptive, or even simply enumerative, of the varieties of domestic Pigeons & Fowls or Ducks kept by the Chinese; & likewise of the Dogs, sheep, cattle &c; but I care more about the former even than the latter.— And the same in regard to the varieties of cultivated plants, but more especially of tobacco & maize; for these latter plants, the work, of course, must not be ancient.—

If any such Chinese agricultural work or Encyclopædia exists in the British Museum but has not been translated, would it be possible for Mr Birch, & would he be so very kind as to take the trouble as to look at it (& as probably saving him a little trouble) & let me be present to note down names of any varieties mentioned, if such are specified.. This would be of extreme interest to me; but I hardly know how great a favour I am asking, for Chinese seems to be so wonderfully difficult to read.—
